en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestones, a central column topped by a lamp, young trees lining the open space, and pedestrians walking. Surrounding the square are Baroque/late‑Renaissance style buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. At the right edge stands a fountain or monument with a seated statue and lions. Behind the buildings rises a tall clock tower with an onion‑shaped spire. Shopfronts with German text are visible on the ground floors.
